text: Think about the word teacher. Is it a person, a place, or a thing? Use a full sentence.
A teacher is a person.
Before, we had one book. Now talk about two books. Tell their noun group in a full sentence.
Books are things.
Think about a playground, where children play. Find and fix one wrong word.
A playground is a place.
What kind of noun is teacher? Start with A teacher and use a full sentence.
A teacher is a person.
What kind of noun is fireworks? Start with Fireworks and use a full sentence.
Fireworks are things.
What kind of noun is school? Start with A school and use a full sentence.
A school is a place.
Invite your friend to paint with you. Start with Do you.
Do you want to paint with me?
Your friend agrees to color with you. Make a suggestion. Start with Let's.
Let's color together.
You are inviting a friend. Find and fix one wrong word.
Do you want to paint with me?
Invite your friend to draw with you. Start with Do you.
Do you want to draw with me?
Your friend agrees to color with you. Suggest the activity in a full sentence. Start with Let's.
Let's color together.
Invite your friend to make a mural with you. Start with Do you.
Do you want to make a mural with me?
A mural is a painting on a wall. This one has a starfish. Tell what the mural shows.
The mural shows a starfish.
Before, there was one mural. Now there are two murals, with a starfish on each. Describe the murals.
The murals show starfish.
One mural has the ocean in it. Find and fix one wrong word.
The mural shows the ocean.
One wall painting has seaweed in it. What does the mural show? Use a full sentence. Start with The mural.
The mural shows seaweed.
There are two murals. Both have the ocean in them. Tell what the murals show. Start with The murals.
The murals show the ocean.
One mural has two jellyfish in it. Tell what the mural shows, including the number. Start with The mural.
The mural shows two jellyfish.
Use the paint card. Tell how we make green paint. Start with We.
We mix blue and yellow to make green.
Before, we made green paint. Now Ava makes orange with red and yellow. Describe Ava. Start with She.
She mixes red and yellow to make orange.
Use the paint card. Find and fix one wrong word about the paint result.
We mix red and blue to make purple.
Use the paint card. Tell how you make orange paint. Start with I.
I mix red and yellow to make orange.
Use the paint card. Tell how we make green paint. Start with We.
We mix blue and yellow to make green.
Use the paint card. Tell how you make purple paint. Start with I.
I mix red and blue to make purple.
The title is Busy Birds. The first words are wings and nests. What do you think the text is about?
I think the text is about birds.
The new title is Orange All Around. It begins with orange walls and hats. Predict the new topic.
I think the text is about a color.
The title is Busy Birds. The first words are wings and nests. Find and fix one wrong word in the prediction.
I think the text is about birds.
The title is Life Under Water. The first words are jellyfish and starfish. Predict the topic. Start with I think.
I think the text is about ocean animals.
The title is Purple in the Park. It begins with purple flowers and shirts. Predict the topic. Start with I think.
I think the text is about the color purple.
The title is All About Wall Art. It begins with large paintings on walls. Predict the topic. Start with I think.
I think the text is about murals.
The ball is red and the kite is red. Compare their colors. Start with The ball.
The ball and the kite are the same color.
Before, the ball and kite were red. Now the kite is blue and the ball stays red. Compare their colors.
The ball and the kite are different colors.
Both hats are pink. Find and fix one wrong word in the sentence.
The hats are the same color.
The ball is red and the kite is red. Compare their colors in one full sentence. Start with The ball and the kite.
The ball and the kite are the same color.
The ball is red and the kite is blue. Compare their colors in one full sentence. Start with The ball and the kite.
The ball and the kite are different colors.
Both shells are gray. Compare their colors. Start with The shells.
The shells are the same color.
